objects.name: Analytic 2066
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a field device loading a modified autorun image (boot read-only memory, bootloader firmware) detected by a discrepancy between the device's declared firmware hash and the authorized firmware inventory hash, with post-reboot device behavior diverging from expected (unexpected protocols active, unanticipated network connections). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
